payload.question: The Lincoln City Council held a public hearing on an ordinance regulating food trucks on July 22, 2025. On what date did it waive the second reading and adopt that ordinance?
How many times in total is Mayor Andreatta recorded as voting no in the minutes of the Lincoln City Council meetings of July 22, 2025 and August 12, 2025?

Which Stantec task order did the Lincoln City Council authorize for the larger amount: the Sewer Master Plan Update on December 10, 2024, or the Q Street Sewer Lift Station Rehabilitation Project on March 11, 2025?
payload.answer: The Sewer Master Plan Update task order of December 10, 2024 ($523,852, against $192,500 for the Q Street project).

payload.question: How many votes in which all five Lincoln council members voted aye are recorded in the minutes of the January 14, 2025 and February 25, 2025 regular meetings combined?
How many more no votes did the Lincoln Planning Commission record on Resolution 2025-07 at its May 21, 2025 meeting than on Resolution 2023-21 at its October 18, 2023 meeting?
How many motions in total were offered by Commissioner Hutchinson in the Lincoln Planning Commission minutes of October 18, 2023 and May 21, 2025?
Who was appointed Mayor of Lincoln for 2026 at the December 9, 2025 meeting, and was that person already a council member at the roll call of the December 10, 2024 meeting?
payload.answer: Richard Pearl; no, he was an incoming council member who took the oath of office during the December 10, 2024 meeting.

payload.question: By how many dollars did the total grant awards to the Lincoln Police Department reflected on January 14, 2025 exceed the total grant awards to the Library reflected on December 10, 2024?
In the minutes of the Lincoln City Council meetings of September 23, 2025 and December 9, 2025 combined, how many votes were recorded with a council member absent?

The Lincoln Planning Commission recommended the Lincoln Place Tentative Subdivision Map on July 19, 2023. What new expiration date did the City Council set for that map when it approved a two-year extension on September 9, 2025?
How many more individuals are listed as addressing the Seattle City Council during public comment at its February 27, 2024 meeting than at its March 5, 2024 meeting?
Approval of the minutes of the February 27, 2024 Seattle City Council meeting was postponed at the March 5, 2024 meeting. On what date were those minutes then approved and signed?
How many vote tallies of the full City Council, not counting committee recommendations, are recorded in the minutes of the June 13, 2023 and March 5, 2024 Seattle City Council meetings combined?
Which Seattle City Council meeting ran longer from call to order to adjournment, the one on June 13, 2023 or the one on September 2, 2025, and by how many minutes?
payload.answer: The June 13, 2023 meeting, by 4 minutes (2:02 p.m. to 3:26 p.m. is 84 minutes; 2:04 p.m. to 3:24 p.m. is 80 minutes).

payload.question: Across the Land Use Committee meetings of June 28, 2023 and May 1, 2024, how many council bills did the committee recommend that the City Council pass, with or without amendment?
How did Councilmember Strauss vote on each council bill that the Land Use Committee recommended for passage at its meetings of June 28, 2023 and May 1, 2024?
payload.answer: In favor of CB 120591, opposed to CB 120581, and in favor of CB 120749.

payload.question: Which councilmember presided over the Land Use Committee meeting of June 28, 2023, and which one presided over its meeting of May 1, 2024?
payload.answer: Councilmember Strauss presided on June 28, 2023 and Councilmember Morales on May 1, 2024.

payload.question: In the minutes of the Seattle City Council meetings of February 27, 2024 and September 2, 2025 combined, how many vote tallies show exactly 8 members in favor?
Which councilmember was excused from the Seattle City Council meeting of February 27, 2024, and which one from the meeting of September 2, 2025?
payload.answer: Strauss was excused on February 27, 2024 and Hollingsworth on September 2, 2025.
